content:
**Gunslinger Master** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

+10 max Onslaught stacks. Gain Onslaught stacks over time and spend them on attacks.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 3 | Gain Onslaught stacks over time and spend them on attacks, +10 max stacks. | 0004A09F | 

Before Update 58 Gunslinger Master was called "Master Gunslinger," and it provided 10%/15%/20% more damage to non-automatic pistols per rank.

Vault Boy's pose on the card is a reference to the classic Han Solo pose
